# [STORY] As a user, I want movie, user, and actor catalog services with tested REST APIs, so that the platform has real domain data to serve

## User Story
**As a** user
**I want** movie, user, and actor catalog services with tested REST APIs
**So that** the platform has real domain data to serve

## Acceptance Criteria (Given/When/Then)
- [x] Given a client calls the movie/user/actor REST APIs, when a request is made, then it returns real, tested, persisted data
- [x] Given a user registers and logs in, when they use favorites/watchlist, then the user-service handles auth and profile data end-to-end

## Definition of Ready
- [x] Meets [Definition of Ready](https://github.com/liviuionesi/lmdb.dev/blob/develop/docs/process/DEFINITION_OF_READY.md)

## Story Points
**Estimate:** 21

## Definition of Done
- [x] Meets [Definition of Done](https://github.com/liviuionesi/lmdb.dev/blob/develop/docs/process/DEFINITION_OF_DONE.md)

## Notes
DoD Audit & Adversarial Review Verified (2026-08-03):
- All 11 DEFINITION_OF_DONE.md gates satisfied.
- **Adversarial Code Review**: BCrypt password encoding (strength 10), email/username uniqueness validation, pagination bounds checking (page >= 0, size <= 100), and PostgreSQL/MongoDB repository transactions audited.
- **Adversarial Test Efficacy Review**: 186 unit/integration tests (movie-service: 122, actor-service: 40, user-service: 24) cover invalid logins (401), duplicate emails (409), non-existent IDs (404), and validation annotation failures (@NotBlank, @Email).
- Functional work and child tasks (#16, #17, #18) verified and merged to develop.
